license_scope: Principal dictionary/schema as expressly declared by pinned README; separately licensed reverse lookup files excluded.
review_policy: Quarantine noncanonical phonetic notation with complete physical source line, raw text/reading/percentage and reason; do not strip tilde markers from emoji codes.
scope: Only jyut6ping3.dict.yaml physical explicit pairs; no essay, rich translation dictionary, reverse lookups, OpenCC binaries or native components.
selection_status: selected additional default source; preserves earlier source pairs; no claim of independent human linguistic approval
source_lineage_status: The current README expressly declares principal data CC BY 4.0. Per-row/category origin and the principal table generation recipe were not found. Initial 2023 source had an explicitly ODbL maps table, removed before the replacement monolith was added; current monolith inheritance of those rows is not established. Explicit table rows are not independent proof of human authorship.
weight_policy: Every newly added pair has weight0 as frequency unknown; raw source percentages are preserved only in the unmodified snapshot and are never treated as cross-corpus frequencies, reading probabilities or replacement weights.
